Name: b's Alternative Cat Statues
Author: AuraMaybe
Description:
A very simple mod to get me used to working with Content Patcher. I've always found the end-game reward statues to be a little... [i]drab[/i], considering how powerful they are, and it's always irked me that the statue of true perfection doesn't match the other two; plus the statue of perfection is so pink compared to the nice purple of iridium.

So, this is my solution! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4366]Iridium Recolor Mod[/url] (open permissions) is absolutely beautiful, and I smooshed a few of the options together to make some vanilla-coloured statues. This was definitely more of a personal project, but I liked the way they turned out, so onto Nexus they go!

[i]Possible future updates:
[list]
[*]Config options to turn off color highlights on the koban coins
[*]Config to make the True Perfection statue dark purple again, with/without shiny paws
[*](Hesitant) Compatibility with other endgame statue mods (Generosity, Fortune, Angler's Woe)
[/list]﻿[/i]

Manifest.Name: Perfection Statues Replacer
Manifest.Description: Shines up and unifies the end-game reward statues using 6480's wonderful art.
Manifest.Author: aura_maybe
